question: Sulochana Chavan is a celebrated _________ singer who was awarded the Padma award in 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lavani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Sulochana Chavan** is renowned for her contribution to **Lavani music**.

• She was awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2022 for her significant contributions to the field of art.

• Lavani is a traditional folk dance and music form of **Maharashtra**.

• Sulochana Chavan is often referred to as the **‘Queen of Lavani’** for her mastery and popularization of this genre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Lavani**

• Lavani is a genre of music popular in Maharashtra and southern Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu.

• The word Lavani is derived from the word 'Lavanya' which means beauty.

• It is noted for its powerful rhythm and is performed to the dholki, a percussion instrument.

• Traditionally, the songs are sung by female artists, but male artists may also occasionally sing them.

• **Carnatic Music**

• Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with the southern part of the Indian subcontinent, with its area roughly confined to four modern states of India: Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.

• It is characterized by its own unique elements such as composition (kritis), improvisation (manodharma), and swara (notes).

• **Ghazal**

• Ghazal is a poetic form consisting of rhyming couplets and a refrain, with each line sharing the same meter.

• A ghazal may be understood as a poetic expression of both the pain of loss or separation and the beauty of love in spite of that pain.

• **Sufi Music**

• Sufi music is the devotional music of the Sufis, inspired by the works of Sufi poets like Rumi, Hafiz, Bulleh Shah, and Khwaja Ghulam Farid.

• Sufi music seeks to unite listeners with the Divine and create a state of spiritual ecstasy.
